The necklace features a central gold-toned heart-shaped locket pendant with an engraved floral design. Above the pendant is a decorative collar section composed of pink oval cabochon stones set in intricate metal filigree, interspersed with faceted clear/grey beads and smaller pink pearls. The chain extends outwards with similar beaded and metallic elements.
